title: Understanding Logistic Regression
text: In logistic regression, the probability of the binary outcome is modeled using the logistic function. This function maps any real-valued number into the $$(0,1)$$ interval, which represents probabilities. Can you recall the formula for the logistic function?

title: Sketching the Logistic Function
text: Try sketching the logistic function. It has an S-shaped curve, starting near $$0$$, increasing rapidly around the midpoint, and leveling off near $$1$$. How does this shape help you understand the probability at a specific value of $$x$$?

title: Evaluating the Logistic Function
text: If the logistic function is given by $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-x\right)}}$$, what is the value when $$x=1$$?

title: Interpreting the Probability
text: Once you have the value from the logistic function, remember that it represents the probability of the outcome being $$1$$ given $$x$$. How does this probability relate to the options provided?
